# Plan B Brazil

> Independent real estate investment advisory in Santa Catarina, Brazil.
> Konstantin Bievskikh, CRECI-SC 59616-F. Based in Florianópolis.
> Research-driven analysis for international investors buying property remotely.
> Languages: English, Russian, Portuguese.

Plan B Brazil is not a brokerage marketing arm. It publishes independent market
research on Santa Catarina real estate — district-level pricing, developer track
records, yield analysis, tax and residency implications — and advises foreign
investors (typically $150K–$500K) purchasing remotely.

## City Reports

- [Florianópolis Investment Report 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/florianopolis-investment-report-2026): Brazil's Silicon Island — population growth, infrastructure catalysts, price trends, rental market, outlook through 2030.
- [Balneário Camboriú Investment Report 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/balneario-camboriu-investment-report-2026): Brazil's luxury coastal high-rise market — pricing, trends, developer landscape, investment outlook.
- [Itapema Investment Report 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/itapema-investment-report-2026): Santa Catarina's fastest-growing coastal market — Meia Praia pricing, growth catalysts, recommendations.
- [Porto Belo Investment Report 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/porto-belo-investment-report-2026): Eco-luxury coastal market — Beto Carrero World catalyst, nature-focused development.
- [Rancho Queimado Investment Report 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/rancho-queimado-investment-report-2026): Santa Catarina's most affordable entry point — rural lifestyle, gated-community potential.

## District Guides (Florianópolis)

- [Jurerê Internacional Investment Guide](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/jurere-internacional-investment-guide): Santa Catarina's most prestigious address — highest prices, highest liquidity, most resilient to downturns.
- [Canasvieiras Investment Guide](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/canasvieiras-investment-guide): Budget-friendly entry into Florianópolis north — best yield-to-price ratio in the region.
- [Ingleses Investment Guide](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/ingleses-investment-guide): Most stable rental market in northern Florianópolis — consistent tourist demand.
- [Campeche Investment Guide](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/campeche-investment-guide): Florianópolis district with the highest upside — new urban center, airport proximity.

## Market Reports & Strategy

- [Best Areas to Invest in Santa Catarina 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/best-areas-to-invest-in-santa-catarina-2026): Comparison of top investment destinations — Jurerê, Itapema, Balneário Camboriú, Porto Belo and more.
- [Brazil 2026-2027 Market Strategy](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/brazil-market-strategy-2026-2027): Why segment choice matters more than city choice as the market stops moving as one front.
- [Santa Catarina Market Outlook 2027](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/santa-catarina-market-outlook-2027): Forecasts, growth projections, infrastructure catalysts shaping the market.
- [Rental Yield Report Santa Catarina 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/rental-yield-report-santa-catarina-2026): Short-term vs long-term yields, occupancy rates, rental income projections by area.

## Buying, Tax & Residency

- [Brazil Residency Through Real Estate 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/vnzh-braziliya-nedvizhimost): How the investor residency permit actually works — thresholds, timeline to citizenship, documents. Explained with an immigration lawyer.
- [How to Buy Property in Brazil: Steps and Costs 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/kak-kupit-nedvizhimost-braziliya): CPF, bank account, transfer, contract, registration — exact costs at every stage plus a developer due-diligence checklist.
- [Capital Gains Tax on Real Estate Sales in Brazil 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/nalog-prodazha-nedvizhimost-braziliya): The 15% rule, the progressive scale, and the legal reinvestment exemption.
- [Buying Property Through an SPE in Brazil 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/spe-struktura-nedvizhimost-braziliya): How Sociedade de Propósito Específico structures work, the legal protection gap, and investor risk.
- [Starting a Business in Brazil Alone](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/starting-a-business-in-brazil-2026): 22 steps instead of 13, up to 180 days, a mandatory local representative — how foreigners actually register a company.

## Guides

- [Brazil Investment Guide 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/brazil-investment-guide-2026): The full 47-page master guide — market overview, legal framework, taxes, step-by-step buying process.
- [Brazil for Dummies](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/brazil-for-dummies-culture-guide): Mentality, language, money, safety, and everyday life in Brazil, without the gloss or the fear-mongering.
- [Practical Guide for Newcomers to Florianópolis](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/newcomers-guide-florianopolis): Transport, schools, healthcare, shopping — your first months on the island.

## Developer Reviews

- [CFL Construtora Developer Review 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/cfl-construtora-developer-review-2026): One of Santa Catarina's most established developers — track record, quality, reputation.
- [STV Construções Developer Review 2026](https://planbbrazil.com/research/report/stv-construcoes-developer-review-2026): The developer that moved its HQ to Porto Belo — a proven 300% appreciation case and founder interview.
